instagram.caption:
Unpopular opinion: stealth games need a comeback.

Splinter Cell made shadows a weapon. We have barely seen a new one in over a decade. Hitman's best moments come from patience and planning, not from shooting your way out. Metal Gear Solid 3 let you beat The End by waiting a week for him to die of old age. Agree?
